test_title: PYST 102: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 11 Jan, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No coats are pants.

All pants are shirts.

Some shirts are coats.

**Conclusions:**

I. No coats are shirts.

II. Some shirts are pants.

III. Some pants are coats.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is given below according to the given information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a19f16b3833e2e2790596ab1e728e0566545ebf81a92c8adb49d017332f04467.png] 

Conclusion:

I. No coats are shirts → **Does not follow → **(As, some shirt are coats. So No coats are shirts in not definitely followed).

II. Some shirts are pants→ **Follow → **(As, All pants are shirts. So some shirts are pants is definitely followed).

III. Some pants are coats → **Does not follow **→ (As, No coats are pants. So some pants are coats is not definitely followed).

**Only conclusion II follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
